question: What is the meaning of description in relation to material information?
description: The description in relation to material information provides a detailed account of the raw material used, including its composition and criticality. It also includes information about the origin, product name/details, object ID, manufacturer article number, location in the building, warranties, service life, condition assessment, and temporal information. This comprehensive description helps in understanding the material's properties, origin, and usage in construction products.
